headline: CHC @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 3.97 at STL 3.23, with a projected total of 7.19. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: CHC moved -0.50 runs while STL moved -1.46, changing the projected margin by +0.95 runs. The projected total fell -1.96, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ben Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alex Bregman, Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Michael Conforto, Victor Scott II because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
